results.title: Special Story: Teachers Protest in Bhubaneswar Over Guest Teacher Appointments
results.description: #ଭ ୀଷଣ_ବର୍ଷାରେ_ଗର୍ଜିଲେ_ଶିକ୍ଷକ ଚାରି ଦଫା ଦାବି ନେଇ ଭୁବନେଶ୍ବର ଗାନ୍ଧି ମାର୍ଗରେ ଗର୍ଜିଲେ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ଓ କର୍ମଚାରୀ। ରାଜ୍ୟରେ ଶିକ୍ଷାଦାନ ବାଧାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ନହେବା ପାଇଁ ଅତିଥି ଶିକ୍ଷକ ନିଯୁକ୍ତିକୁ ରାଜ୍ୟ ସରକାରଙ୍କ ଅନୁମୋଦନ। ତେବେ ଅବସର ପରେ ଥଇଥାନ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତିକୁ ଅଲ୍ ଓଡ଼ିଶା ଆଶାୟୀ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ସଂଘ କରିଛି ବିରୋଧ। ସେପଟେ ବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ ଓ ଗଣଶିକ୍ଷା ମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ କହିଛନ୍ତି ପିଲାଙ୍କ ସ୍ବାର୍ଥକୁ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିରେ ରଖି ଅସ୍ଥାୟୀ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ନିଯୁକ୍ତି ପାଇଁ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ହୋଇଛି। ତେବେ ସ୍ଥାୟୀ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ନିଯୁକ୍ତି ପାଇଁ ସରକାର ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଜାରି ରଖିଛନ୍ତି। ... #OdishaTeachers #TeacherProtest #GuestTeacher #OdishaEducation #BhubaneswarNews #SpecialStory #OdishaTV #OTV Teachers and employees staged a protest on Gandhi Marg in Bhubaneswar with four-point demands. results.title: LG Sinha Expresses Grief Over Fatal Road Accident in Rajouri
results.description: Rajouri, August 16: Jammu and Kashmir Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha has expressed deep anguish over the loss of lives in an unfortunate road accident in Kotranka area of Rajouri district. In a post on X, the Lieutenant Governor said he was “deeply pained” by the loss of lives in the accident and conveyed his heartfelt condolences to the bereaved families. Sinha also prayed for the early recovery of those injured in the mishap. He said he had directed the district administration to ensure the best possible treatment for the injured and provide all necessary assistance. The accident has caused grief in the Kotranka area, with authorities responding to the situation and extending support to the affected families and injured persons.
